verdict: Latte is lower in calories and higher in protein. Bubble tea is still fine, especially with less sugar and a small size.
why: A 500 ml bubble tea is an estimated 350 kcal, a 350 ml latte around 190 kcal. A 160 kcal difference.
Latte has 10 g protein from milk, bubble tea only 4 g. Latte helps more with feeling full.
Fat is the same (10 g), but bubble tea has more sugar and calorie-dense pearls.
Bubble tea easily becomes an extra 'snack' between meals that we don't count as calories.
when_a: Bubble tea is okay once in a while as a treat. Choose a small size, 0-30% sugar and fewer toppings.
when_b: Latte suits a morning or afternoon drink at the office, especially without added syrup.
tip: For bubble tea, choose the lowest sugar level and just one topping. For latte, avoid flavoured syrups and whipped cream.

faq.a: Yes, pearls are starch soaked in sugar. One big spoonful of pearls can add calories significantly. Reduce or skip them.

faq.q: Is a latte with oat milk lower in calories?
faq.a: It depends on the recipe. Sometimes it's about the same or even higher. Size and added sugar matter more.
